versions.content: The status of a certificate can be reset by calling KeyM_ SetCertificate() with the corresponding certificate ID but with length information 0. The function will return E_OK and will reset the status of the certificate to KEYM_ CERTIFICATE_NOT_AVAILABLE (see KeyM_CertGetStatus()).
